title: Obsidian vault export layer + dogfood on real Claude Code transcripts
description: Build 'memsub vault sync --vault PATH [--namespace NS]': exports the episodic store to a plain-markdown Obsidian-compatible vault (one note per memory, YAML frontmatter, provenance section, wiki-links for shared entities and supersede chains, per-namespace index notes, top-level MOC). Idempotent/re-runnable: stable id-based filenames, update changed notes, remove notes for deleted memories. Then dogfood: run memsub extract -> consolidate -> vault sync over Rustom's real Claude Code transcripts at ~/.claude/projects/ into ~/memsub-vault (outside any git repo). Design notes in docs/obsidian-layer.md, dogfood report in docs/dogfood-2026-07-12.md.
design: Reuse Episode/EpisodicStore schema as-is, no schema changes. New file memsub/vault.py: sync_vault(store, vault_path, namespace=None) -> VaultSyncResult. Entity extraction reuses the same naive capitalized-word regex idea as memsub/sleep.py's _extract_entities for shared-entity links, kept dependency-free like the rest of the repo. Vault is one-way export only, no vault-to-store editing (documented as deliberately out of scope).
acceptance_criteria: 1) memsub vault sync CLI command exists with tests in tests/test_vault.py, pytest green. 2) Idempotent: running sync twice with no store changes produces zero file diffs. 3) Re-running after store changes updates changed notes and deletes notes for episodes no longer in scope. 4) Filenames are filesystem-safe slug+short-id. 5) Frontmatter includes id/namespace/kind/type(observed|inferred)/status/created/last-updated/last-used/confidence(if present). 6) Superseded memories remain in vault and link forward via 'superseded by [[...]]'. 7) Per-namespace index note + top-level MOC note exist and list real files. 8) docs/obsidian-layer.md written: what it does, what it deliberately does not do (no vault-to-store editing), 2-3 second-layer ideas without building them. 9) Real pipeline run over sampled real transcripts from /home/user/.claude/projects/, vault written to /home/user/memsub-vault (not inside any git repo), nothing sensitive committed to the repo. 10) docs/dogfood-2026-07-12.md written with real counts/timings, no fabricated numbers. 11) Manually spot-check >=3 generated notes (frontmatter parses, wikilinks resolve).
close_reason: Vault export layer (memsub/vault.py + CLI + 16 tests, docs/obsidian-layer.md) built and dogfooded end-to-end over 14 sampled real Claude Code transcripts into /home/user/memsub-vault (57 notes, idempotent rerun verified, 0 broken wikilinks). Report: docs/dogfood-2026-07-12.md. All pre-registered acceptance checks passed; 193/193 tests green.
